source_snapshot.items: Boot Time PPR with Correctable Errors
source_snapshot.procedure: Configure threshold2/Soft-PPR/fast-boot; inject the same mapped-row CE twice, proving1/2 then threshold/qualification; reset and verify same-row PPR/DramMask.
source_snapshot.criteria: Serial threshold progression, extlog_mem_event, extmem_event_log, bad-row qualification and boot repair.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic logs omit the two-stage/same-row/reset chain.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores literal two injections, ELog stages, reset and repair gates.

old_problem: The sacrificial DRAM row/memDevs mapping, exact threshold/ELog decoder, NVRAM same-row persistence, Intel harness and reset recovery are not authorized project inputs.
disposition_reason: ED-16 and ED-18 require an approved injector, isolation, Recovery and complete reset-to-OS-ready evidence. PASS is causal across two same-row CEs and one boot; neither generic corrected logs nor a nonzero unrelated DramMask can resolve the missing row identity and firmware oracle.
decision_basis: Directly read all18 XLSX cells and full history2544.
Preserved exact first1/2 then second-threshold sequence, extlog/extmem, row qualification, reset and DramMask/PprRepairStatus.
Kept Runtime Row Sparing non-required as the source states and rejected extra injections.
No injector, BIOS change, reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GNR two-CE same-row boot-time Soft PPR
test_case.purpose: Prove two CEs on one approved row cross threshold, persist that row, and cause one successful boot-time Soft PPR repair.
required_package: Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB and reset recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator establishes immutable row/settings baseline; injects one exact CE and captures1/2+extlog; injects the second identical-row CE and captures threshold, qualification+extmem; performs one approved itp.resettarget; correlates the same row, nonzero DramMask and passed repair status; restores settings and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: Only the second same-row CE reaches threshold; firmware persists/qualifies that row, one reset completes PPR for it, and expected ELog/DramMask/status evidence appears without wrong severity or recovery failure.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires same-row identity at every stage, literal1/2-to-threshold progression, both ELog types, one attributable reset, same-row passed repair, healthy OS-ready state and full restoration; any discontinuity, crash, extra injection or missing oracle fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Approve a sacrificial row and exact harness before injection.
Stop after any wrong target/severity or missing first-stage evidence.
One reset only with continuous serial/OOB capture.
No blanket log clearing, automatic reinjection or reset.
expected_evidence: Second CE threshold, qualification and extmem
Continuous reset/boot same-row PPR and DramMask/status
test_case.recovery: On anomaly preserve evidence, use approved OOB recovery without reinjection, restore PPR/fast-boot/DFX/GRUB settings and verify DIMM plus OS/BMC health.

source_conflict.reason: The settings, two-CE threshold stages and boot-time repair criterion are coherent.

blocked.reason: Exact operation exists; harness, row mapping and firmware oracle are critical RPUC inputs.
